newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat calls to wish Netanyahu happy new year.
newsitem.headline: Arafat calls to wish Netanyahu happy new year.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat called Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Sunday to wish him "shana tova" -- a happy Jewish new year.

Netanyahu's office said the prime minister thanked Arafat in the phone call on the eve of Yom Kippur, the Jewish Day of Atonement, and said: "We stand at the start of a year that will be a good year for Israel and the Palestinians."
Before his election in May, the right-wing Netanyahu vowed never to meet the Palestinian leader as prime minister. Under U.S. pressure, he met Arafat on September 4.
An Israeli statement said Netanyahu voiced disappointment during the phone call at Palestinian charges there had been no progress in peace negotiations.
"The reality as everyone knows is different and there is progress all the time," said the statement. It did not elaborate.
Talks on implementing peace deals are due to resume next week. Arafat expressed hope in the phone call that their contacts would help the the peace process succeed.
